description: Backend intelligence extensions: AI application generator endpoint (Task D), application strength scoring (Task E), learning completion + micro-assessment (Task F), feedback→AIStudentProfile update (Task G), certificate audit log (Task O), AI safety guards (Task M), and error handling completeness (Task N). Depends on FEAT-001 (SkillEvidence model and calculateConfidence).
steps: MODIFY backend/controllers/aiController.js — ADD generateApplication handler: POST /generate-application. Load User by req.user.id (skills, projects, experience, education fields). Load SkillEvidence for user. Load Internship by req.body.internshipId (404 if not found). Guard: if user has no skills and SkillEvidence is empty, return 400 {success:false, message:'Please complete your profile with skills before generating an application.'}. Compose prompt context object {profileSkills, evidenceSkills: array of {skillName, confidenceScore}, internshipTitle, internshipOrg, internshipRequiredSkills, internshipDescription}. Call aiClient.truthGuard or aiClient.chat with the context and instruction 'Generate a professional cover letter using ONLY the provided profile data. Do not fabricate company names, certifications, or experiences not listed.' Capture result as coverLetter string. Run truthGuard check on result. Return {success:true, coverLetter, truthGuardIssues: truthGuardResult?.issues||[], isEstimate:true, disclaimer:'Based on available profile data. Always review before submitting.'}. Add generateApplication to module.exports.

MODIFY backend/routes/aiRoutes.js — import generateApplication and add: router.post('/generate-application', protect, generateApplication). Read aiRoutes.js first to confirm the existing pattern, then add without disturbing existing routes.

MODIFY backend/controllers/internshipQualityController.js — ADD getApplicationStrength handler: GET /application/:applicationId/strength. Import Application = require('../models/Application'), SkillEvidence = require('../models/SkillEvidence'). Load Application by id. Load Internship from application.internship. Load SkillEvidence for application.student. required = internship.requiredSkills || internship.skills || []. matched = required.filter(s => evidenceDocs.find(e => e.skillName.toLowerCase()===s.toLowerCase())). fitScore = required.length>0 ? matched.length/required.length*100 : 50. evidenceScore = matched.length>0 ? avg(matched.map(s=>evidenceDocs.find(e=>e.skillName===s)?.confidenceScore||0)) : 0. completenessScore: count filled fields in application (coverLetter, resumeUrl/resume, skills array in application) out of 3, *100/3. strength = Math.round(fitScore*0.4 + evidenceScore*0.4 + completenessScore*0.2). Return {applicationStrength: strength, breakdown:{fitScore, evidenceScore, completenessScore}, disclaimer:'Score based on available data.'}. Add to module.exports.
MODIFY backend/routes/internshipQualityRoutes.js — import getApplicationStrength. Add: router.get('/application/:applicationId/strength', protect, getApplicationStrength).

CREATE backend/models/MicroAssessment.js: {user: ObjectId ref User required, skillName: String required, questions:[{question:String, options:[String], correctIndex:Number}], userAnswers:[Number], score:Number, maxScore:Number, completedAt:{type:Date, default:Date.now}, evidenceAdded:{type:Boolean, default:false}}. Export as 'MicroAssessment'.

MODIFY backend/controllers/adaptiveLearningController.js — ADD completeLearning handler: PUT /api/adaptive-learning/:guideId/complete-learning (separate from markGuideCompleted). Body: {assessmentScore: Number 0-100, skillsTargeted: [String]}. For each skill in skillsTargeted: find SkillEvidence for user+skill (upsert if not found). strength = assessmentScore>80?'strong':assessmentScore>60?'moderate':'weak'. Build evidenceSource entry {type:'assessment', description:'Completed adaptive learning guide', strength, verifiedAt: new Date()}. Push to evidenceSources. Recalculate confidenceScore using imported calculateConfidence from skillEvidenceController. Save. After all updates, call createAndNotify(req.app, {recipient:req.user.id, title:'Learning Completed!', message:`Great work! Your skill evidence has been updated.`, type:'success', priority:'medium', link:'/dashboard/career'}). Return {updated: skillsTargeted, disclaimer:'Confidence scores updated based on assessment'}. Import SkillEvidence, { calculateConfidence } from skillEvidenceController, createAndNotify.

ADD submitAssessment handler to backend/controllers/adaptiveLearningController.js: POST /assessment. Body: {skillName, questions:[{question,options,correctIndex}], userAnswers:[Number]}. Validate body (400 if skillName missing). Calculate score: count userAnswers[i]===questions[i].correctIndex. maxScore = questions.length. percentage = Math.round(score/maxScore*100). Save MicroAssessment doc. Find or create SkillEvidence for user+skillName. strength = percentage>80?'strong':percentage>60?'moderate':'weak'. Push assessment evidenceSource. Recalculate confidenceScore. Save SkillEvidence. Set evidenceAdded:true on MicroAssessment. Return {score, maxScore, percentage, skillConfidenceUpdated: true, newConfidenceScore}. Import MicroAssessment model.

MODIFY backend/routes/adaptiveLearningRoutes.js — import completeLearning and submitAssessment. Add: router.put('/:guideId/complete-learning', protect, completeLearning); router.post('/assessment', protect, submitAssessment).

MODIFY backend/controllers/feedbackController.js — in submitFeedbackResponse, after the existing SkillAssessment updates block, add: find or create AIStudentProfile for studentId. For each highRatedDimension ([dim, rating]): skillName = DIMENSION_SKILL_MAP[dim]. If skillName not in profile.skillProfile, push it. Add to performanceHistory (if it exists on schema — check AIStudentProfile schema first; AIStudentProfile does NOT have performanceHistory field, so add to weaknesses removal / strengths addition instead): if rating>=4 and skillName not in profile.strengths, push to profile.strengths; if skillName in profile.weaknesses, remove it. Save profile. Use AIStudentProfile = require('../models/AIStudentProfile') (already imported via SkillAssessment — but AIStudentProfile is NOT imported in feedbackController.js, add the require).

MODIFY backend/controllers/certificateController.js — add ActivityLog = require('../models/ActivityLog') at top. In issueCertificate: after cert is created, add ActivityLog.create({user: req.user.id, action:'certificate_issued', details:{certificateId:cert.certificateId, studentId, internshipId}, ip:req.ip, userAgent:req.headers['user-agent']}). In verifyCertificate: after cert updated, add ActivityLog.create({user: req.user.id, action:'certificate_verified', details:{certificateId:req.params.certificateId}, ip:req.ip, userAgent:req.headers['user-agent']}). In revokeCertificate: after cert updated, add ActivityLog.create({user:req.user.id, action:'certificate_revoked', details:{certificateId:req.params.certificateId, reason:req.body.reason}, ip:req.ip, userAgent:req.headers['user-agent']}).

REVIEW backend/controllers/skillEvidenceController.js, careerIntelligenceController.js — every async handler already uses asyncHandler wrapper (confirm during implementation). If any handler is missing try/catch and NOT using asyncHandler, wrap it. Add 404 returns for missing documents. Add 400 returns for missing required body fields (skillName in upsertSkillEvidence, internshipId in generateApplication). This is a correctness pass, not new features.

MODIFY backend/controllers/aiController.js (AI safety pass) — in getAIIntelligence and analyzeResumeAI: these already return errors for missing resume. Add isEstimate:true and disclaimer:'Based on available profile data' to the response JSON of analyzeResumeAI (add to the success response data object). In generateApplication already done in step 1. This ensures all AI generation endpoints include safety fields.
acceptance_criteria: POST /api/ai/generate-application with valid internshipId returns {coverLetter, isEstimate:true, disclaimer, truthGuardIssues}
POST /api/ai/generate-application with empty user profile returns 400 with helpful message (not an AI call)
POST /api/adaptive-learning/assessment with {skillName:'React', questions:[...], userAnswers:[...]} returns {score, maxScore, percentage, skillConfidenceUpdated:true}
submitFeedbackResponse with ratings {technicalSkills:5} updates AIStudentProfile.skillProfile and strengths
issueCertificate creates an ActivityLog entry with action='certificate_issued'
verification: cd backend && node server.js — must start without errors
cd backend && node -e "require('./models/MicroAssessment'); console.log('MicroAssessment OK')" — must not throw
cd backend && node -e "require('./controllers/adaptiveLearningController'); console.log('adaptiveLearning controller OK')" — must not throw
findings: All 12 steps implemented. MicroAssessment model created. generateApplication added to aiController with truthGuard + isEstimate/disclaimer. getApplicationStrength added to internshipQualityController. completeLearning and submitAssessment added to adaptiveLearningController importing calculateConfidence from skillEvidenceController. feedbackController updated to import AIStudentProfile and update strengths/skillProfile after high-rated feedback. certificateController updated with ActivityLog entries for issued/verified/revoked actions. analyzeResumeAI updated to include isEstimate and disclaimer in response. Routes registered in respective route files. Route ordering fixed in internshipQualityRoutes (specific /application/:id/strength before /:internshipId). No circular dependencies detected.
